dialogue.content: (こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for your time today.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です今日はご相談ありがとうございます初めに、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 16、男髪型のこと
dialogue.English: 16, male. It's about my hairstyle.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。髪型のことですね。どういったことでお悩みでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. It's about your hairstyle. Could you tell me more about what's troubling you?

dialogue.content: 年末に帰省するから、美容院へ行くつもりなんですが、
dialogue.English: I'm planning to go to the salon when I go home for the New Year's holiday, but...

dialogue.content: ツーブロにしようかなと母に話してたら、父に叱られました
dialogue.English: I was telling my mom that I was thinking of getting a two-block haircut, and my dad scolded me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご相談者さまはツーブロックにしたいと思っているけれど、お父様には叱られてしまったのですね。お父様にはなんと言って叱られたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you'd like to get a two-block haircut, but your father scolded you for it. What exactly did he say when he scolded you?

dialogue.content: お前特待生の意味わかってんのかと怒鳴られました
dialogue.English: He yelled, “Do you even understand what it means to be a scholarship student?”

dialogue.content: なるほど特待生で学校に入られているのですね特待生だと、髪型の制限などもあるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: I understand. So you're attending school on a scholarship. Are there any hairstyle restrictions for scholarship students?

dialogue.content: 校則は、中等部ではツーブロ禁止だったけど、高等部では禁止じゃありませんでも、自分のクラスの副担任が急に、俺らのクラスだけツーブロ禁止と言い始めて
dialogue.English: The school rules banned two-block haircuts in middle school, but it's not banned in high school. However, the assistant homeroom teacher for my class suddenly started saying that two-block cuts are banned only for our class.

dialogue.content: 別の部活の特待生のやつがツーブロにしたら、副担任にグチグチ言われてましたあいつマジでゴミ
dialogue.English: A scholarship student from another club got a two-block cut and the assistant homeroom teacher kept nagging him about it. That teacher is a real piece of trash.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね禁止ではないのに言われると、それはイラつきますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be frustrating to be told that when it's not actually prohibited.

dialogue.content: はい禁止じゃないなら、別に良くないですか？
dialogue.English: Yeah. If it's not banned, then it should be fine, right?

dialogue.content: 確かに、そう思いますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I can certainly see why you would think that.

dialogue.content: なぜ、ご相談者さまのクラスだけ禁止になったのですか
dialogue.English: Do you know why only your class ended up being banned?

dialogue.content: よくわかりません俺らのクラス、バレー部の内進生多いからかも
dialogue.English: I'm not sure. Maybe it's because our class has a lot of students from the volleyball club who came up from the middle school.

dialogue.content: あいつらオラオラだから
dialogue.English: Those guys are really aggressive.

dialogue.content: バレー部はオラついてる人が多いのですね学校の内情に詳しくないので質問させていただくのですが、それでツーブロックが禁止になるのはなぜなんでしょう？身だしなみのルール違反が結構あるのですか？
dialogue.English: So there are a lot of aggressive people in the volleyball club. I'm not familiar with the inner workings of your school, so may I ask, why would that lead to two-block haircuts being banned? Are there a lot of grooming rule violations?

dialogue.content: ルール違反にならないようにみんな工夫してます
dialogue.English: Everyone finds ways to get around the rules without technically breaking them.

dialogue.content: ツーブロ注意されたやつが、それ校則で決まってないですよねと言い返したら、急にうちのクラスだけ禁止とか言い出して、意味わからないです
dialogue.English: The guy who got called out for his two-block cut talked back, saying it wasn't against the school rules. Then the teacher suddenly banned it just for our class. It makes no sense.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご返答ありがとうございます。それはイライラしますね。ご相談者さまは、どうしてツーブロックにしたいと思ったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for explaining. That does sound frustrating. Why did you want to get a two-block haircut?

dialogue.content: かっこいいから
dialogue.English: Because it looks cool.

dialogue.content: 確かに、ツーブロックはカッコ良いですね。
dialogue.English: I agree, two-block cuts do look cool.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 韓国マッシュは禁止されたから、他にするならツーブロしかないかなと思って
dialogue.English: The Korean mash cut was banned, so I thought a two-block was my only other option.

dialogue.content: なるほどどちらもおしゃれな髪型ですね
dialogue.English: I see. Both are stylish hairstyles.

dialogue.content: やっぱり見た目も気になるから
dialogue.English: My appearance is important to me, after all.

dialogue.content: 父は髪型に気を使う時間あるなら練習しろと言うけど
dialogue.English: But my dad says if I have time to worry about my hair, I should be practicing.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。髪型がおしゃれだと素敵ですよね。分かります。お父様には練習しろといって叱られたのですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Having a stylish haircut can feel great. I get it. Did your father scold you by telling you to practice?

dialogue.content: 昨日叱られたのは、練習しろではなかったです
dialogue.English: When he scolded me yesterday, it wasn't about practicing.

dialogue.content: 特待生なんだから、自覚持てって
dialogue.English: He said, “You’re a scholarship student, so act like it.”

dialogue.content: でも内心生ほとんど特待生だし、みんな髪型だって気にしてるし
dialogue.English: But almost all the students who came from the middle school are on scholarships, and they all care about their hair.

dialogue.content: それに、練習めちゃくちゃやってます
dialogue.English: Besides, I practice a ton.

dialogue.content: 帰省する時ぐらいしか美容院行けないから、楽しみにしてたのに
dialogue.English: I can only go to a salon when I go back home, so I was really looking forward to it.

dialogue.content: なるほどそうですよね練習と髪型はイコールではないですもんね練習を頑張っているというのもカッコ良いと思いますせっかくなら髪型もカッコよくしたいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're right, practicing and your hairstyle aren't the same thing. I think working hard at practice is cool, too. And it makes sense that you'd want your hair to look cool as well.

dialogue.content: はい地元の友達と会えるかもしれないし
dialogue.English: Yes, and I might get to see my friends from back home.

dialogue.content: うんうん、それは楽しみですねせっかくなら美容院にも行きたいですよね
dialogue.English: Mhm, that's exciting. It makes sense you'd want to go to the salon for that.

dialogue.content: でも父が昨日怒鳴ったから、母には美容院キャンセルしてって言いました
dialogue.English: But since my dad yelled at me yesterday, I told my mom to cancel the salon appointment.

dialogue.content: そうなのですかそれは悲しいですね…本当に美容院には行かないのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That’s disheartening… Are you really not going to go to the salon?

dialogue.content: 母は、予約はそのまま残しておくから、ゆっくり考えなさいって、LINEしてきました
dialogue.English: My mom sent me a message on LINE saying she's keeping the reservation, so I should take my time and think about it.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いと思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think I should do?

dialogue.content: なるほどそうですね、お母様の言う通りお正月までには、ゆっくり考える時間がありそうです確認なのですが、ご相談者さまとしては、せっかく久しぶりに友達に会うし、髪型もキメて楽しみたいというところでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Well, as your mother said, it seems you have some time to think about it before the New Year. Just to confirm, is it that you want to have your hair done nicely and have a good time, especially since you'll be seeing your friends for the first time in a while?

dialogue.content: 友達に会えるかどうかは、まだ予定決まってないのでわかりません。みんな高校生になって、どんなふうに過ごしてるかわからないし。でも、帰省の時にはいつも同じ美容院に行っていて、かっこよくカットしてもらうのを楽しみにしています。
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if I'll be able to see my friends yet, since we haven't made plans. I don't know what they're all up to now that we're in high school. But I always go to the same salon when I go home, and I look forward to getting a cool haircut.

dialogue.content: いつもは床屋とか、先輩に切ってもらうとかなので
dialogue.English: Usually, I just go to a barber or have a senior student cut it.

dialogue.content: なるほど。それは楽しみになりますね。私個人としては、美容室に行った方が良いと思っています。ただご相談者さまのしたい髪型をクラスで禁止されていることと、お父様が分かってくれていないのですよね？
dialogue.English: I see. That would certainly be something to look forward to. Personally, I think you should go to the salon. However, the issue is that the hairstyle you want is banned in your class, and your father doesn't understand your feelings, correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もし美容室に行くとしたら、ツーブロックでどんな髪型にしてもらう予定でしたか？
dialogue.English: If you were to go to the salon, what kind of two-block style were you planning to get?

dialogue.content: ツーブロにはするけど、一応前髪と横と後ろの長さは決められてるので、校則に違反しないようにしようと思ってました。担当の美容師さんも校則のことわかってるし。
dialogue.English: I was going to get a two-block, but there are rules about the length of the bangs and hair on the sides and back, so I was planning to keep it within the school regulations. My hairstylist knows about the school rules, too.

dialogue.content: 横は少し長くして、頭髪検査の時はアイロンで伸ばして誤魔化そうかなと。前もそれで検査引っかからなかったから。
dialogue.English: I was thinking of leaving the sides a little longer and then straightening them with a flat iron for the hair inspection to get by. It worked before, and I didn't get caught.

dialogue.content: なるほど。今までも校則違反にならないように工夫していらしたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been finding ways to avoid breaking the school rules before.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもそもそも違反なことをするなと父は怒ってきます
dialogue.English: But my dad gets angry and tells me not to do anything that breaks the rules in the first place.

dialogue.content: なるほど。お父様は校則違反などには厳しい方なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is your father strict about things like breaking school rules?

dialogue.content: 特待生だから、ってよく言います
dialogue.English: He often says, “Because you’re a scholarship student.”

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。特待生だからこそ、実際に練習もしっかりしていて、髪型も校則違反にならいなようされいるんですもんね
dialogue.English: I see. And it's precisely because you're a scholarship student that you practice so hard and also try to keep your hairstyle from violating the rules, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 学校から、特待生は一般生のお手本でいなさいと言われています。父が言いたいのは、クラスで禁止されたのなら、お手本なのだからやるなってことですよね。
dialogue.English: The school tells us that scholarship students should be role models for the other students. I guess what my dad means is that if it's banned in my class, I shouldn't do it because I'm supposed to be a role model.

dialogue.content: でも頭ごなしに怒鳴らなくたって良いのに
dialogue.English: But he doesn't have to just yell at me without hearing me out.

dialogue.content: なるほど。頑張っておられるんですね。それで頭ごなしに怒鳴られるのは、お辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're working so hard. It must be very painful to be yelled at like that without any discussion.

dialogue.content: いきなり怒鳴られて、もうすぐ帰省だって楽しみにしてた気持ちが萎えました
dialogue.English: Being yelled at so suddenly just killed my excitement about going home soon.

dialogue.content: それは嫌な気持ちになりますよね。せっかく楽しみにしていたのに。
dialogue.English: That must feel awful, especially when you were looking forward to it so much.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: お父さまとは、よくこのようなことがあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Does this kind of thing happen often with your father?

dialogue.content: はいよく叱られたりします
dialogue.English: Yes, he scolds me a lot.

dialogue.content: 怒られることが多いから、電話かけるのも嫌になったりします
dialogue.English: He gets angry so often that sometimes I don't even want to call him.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それは電話するのも嫌になりますね。お辛いと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. That would make anyone reluctant to call. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: まだまだお話を聞いていたかったのですが、そろそろお時間となってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I would have liked to hear more, but I'm afraid we're almost out of time.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: またお話を聞かせていただければと思います。いつでもいらしてください。
dialogue.English: I hope we can talk again. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for speaking with me today.

dialogue.content: (お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイありがとうございました。いろいろと勉強になりました。評価の方は正直につけていいただければと思っております。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. It was a great learning experience. I would appreciate your honest feedback. Thank you.)
